title: Hollow Country module manifest
description: One manifest per HCModule subclass. tools/package/gen_modules.py validates each manifest against the Enforce code and generates the module's docs/MODULE_STATUS.md use-feature row from it.

name.description: Exactly what the module's GetName() returns.

mod.description: Script mod that owns the module class.

layer.description: Startup phase of the module: StartupPhase() returns HC_PHASE_CORE, _PROVIDER, _FEATURE (default) or _ADDON.

class.description: Enforce class name of the module.

source.description: Repository-relative path of the .c file that defines the class and registers it.

default_on.description: True when every Enable* flag in settings defaults on in the settings registry (always true for a module with no flag).

settings.description: Settings registry keys the module reads: its Enable* admission flags and scoped tuning keys. Every key must be registered with HCAdd and referenced by the module source.

uses.description: [HC Use] feature names the module registers at start, in the order of its MODULE_STATUS row.

uses_source.description: Where the code declares the uses today: a RegisterUses override, or an HCModuleReadiness s_LegacyUses row (not migrated yet; the manifest only records it).

requires_shared_saves.description: What RequiresSharedSaves() returns today (override, or membership of s_HCLegacySaveOwners).

dependencies.description: Bridge or port classes the module depends on; each must be a class defined in the scripts. Dependency calls (Expansion AI, COT, CF) go only through HC bridge classes.

readiness_reasons.description: Reason codes the module publishes in its HCOperationalStatus; each must appear as a string literal in the module source.

status_note.description: Optional text appended to the feature list in the module's MODULE_STATUS row.
